label: Hypothetical neutral follow-up 2: contrary consumer evidence opens a cross-component branch
message: A CI rerun on a second configured consumer reports that direct shared-GUI application checks pass, while an installed consumer reports stale visible state after a valid edit/submit sequence. CI confirms that the consumer package manifest and source revision match the declared inputs, but its test inventory and selected provider differ from the first target. The reporter supplies no trace proving which layer emitted or retained the stale value. No cause or preferred repair is supplied. This is fabricated prospective feedback, not an executed study result.
